details.description: Gemma 7B-IT is a 7-billion-parameter, instruction-tuned, decoder-only text model from Google's original Gemma family, built from the same research used to create the Gemini models. It was trained on 6 trillion tokens of web documents, code and mathematical text, and takes text input to produce English text output. Google's current Gemma documentation groups this first-generation family, together with Gemma 2 and Gemma 3, under a "Legacy Gemma setup" section, with Gemma 4 presented as the current flagship generation.
advantages: Scores 64.3 on MMLU (5-shot), per Google's Gemma 7B-it model card.
Scores 81.2 on HellaSwag, per the model card.
Scores 32.3 (pass@1) on HumanEval for code generation, per the model card.
Scores 46.4 (maj@1) on GSM8K grade-school math, per the model card.
disadvantages: Google's Gemma documentation groups this Gemma 1 family, along with Gemma 2 and 3, under a "Legacy Gemma setup" section, with Gemma 4 as the current flagship generation.
English only, per the model card.
The model card states it has limited common-sense reasoning and difficulty grasping sarcasm and figurative language.
The model card states it may generate factually incorrect or outdated information.
use_cases: Content creation such as poems, scripts and marketing copy
